blockers.resolution: Restrict the controller repository to reviewed actions and require full-SHA pinning.
Provision isolated API and Web build identities and reviewed OCI images pinned by digest, with observed platform/runtime provenance checks equivalent to the fail-closed Ops builder.
Provision least-privilege write/read identities scoped only to the private carrier.

Provision Node v22.22.0 out of band by verifying the pinned official archive, installing only bin/node atomically with no-replace/idempotent revalidation as root:root 0555, retaining rollback toolchains, and attesting the exact binary as tratto-control-web.
Set can_admins_bypass=false for the control-release environment and retain prevent_self_review=true.
Bind ops/control bytes to the signed envelope and install/switch them atomically while the stack is quiesced.
Configure and prove a second Tratto reviewer who is not the workflow initiator or last pusher.
Close the proxy and stop readiness/reconcile units before restoring current, state, timers, or the previous generation.

Use the real root-owned /usr/bin/python3.12 across Control units; attest Ubuntu 24.04, glibc, cp312/SOABI/Py_DEBUG and interpreter access after setpriv to all six runtime users without executing artifact interpreters as root.
Provision the independent runtime verifier and Chrome harness, each pinned by reviewed digest.
Revalidate branch, selected Actions, ledger, and protected-environment controls after environment approval and immediately before OIDC signing without source checkout.
Provision the protected OIDC signer with no product credentials and no source checkout.

Move approvals to a separately protected linear append-only public ledger while dispatching an immutable controller tag/SHA; revalidate ledger ancestry and controls in the signer and rotate host controller pins only through audited dual-pin upgrades.
Merge the reviewed final workflow to protected main and pin its SHA-256 in each append-only approval.
